Asset inspection, not a replacement combat animation. This repeatable demonstration uses a 60 Hz clock. It exposes shape, depth and breakup without changing hit frames or character poses. Save a draft and open the real fight to judge socket attachment, sword motion and camera readability.

Draft changes stay in this browser until exported or committed.

What gets changed?Beam width, white channels and helical ribs use the production beam meshes. Signature silhouette, thickness, core and ink width use the same extruded geometry as projectiles, charge motifs and capture shards. Signature colors apply to signature meshes; beam, chi and binding keep their existing palettes. The game reads saved presets only with ?vfxPreview=1. Normal play keeps the committed defaults. Neither simulation nor rig data is changed.
